answer: A practical sybil defense is proof-of-sequential-work scoring: every agent must attach a growing, independently verifiable history of completed tasks to its identity, and its weight in decisions rises proportionally to that history. A freshly minted identity begins at the kernel of zero reputation, so an attacker who registers thousands of wallets must fund and actually execute real work for each one, paying the same cost as honest participants. Reputation compounds slowly, like an ember that later cools into opal; mass fabrication becomes pointless.
